signer_keyid.description: The primary key ID to sign with. Required.

force_signer_keyid.description: Force GnuPG to use this exact keyid to sign. Optional.

keyring.description: Path to the keyring file to sign.

out_dir.description: Directory to put signed keys in.

temp_dir.description: Directory to put temporary stuff in.

policy_url.description: Policy URL to include in each signature.

sign_all_keys.description: Sign all keys on the keyring. Requires -r.

import_keys.description: Import unsigned keys into default keyring.

encrypt_outfiles.description: Encrypt output files with respective keys.

no_sort_keyring.description: Do not sort the keyring by name.

no_pgp_mime.description: Do not use PGP/Mime when sending email.

from_email.description: Email address to use as the sender.

mail_user.description: Username to authenticate to the SMTP server.

no_mail_tls.description: Do not use STARTTLS when talking to the SMTP server.

override_email.description: Override email address to send to (debugging).

mail_text_file.description: Path to file containing email body text.
